## Assumptions

- All critical pad blocks are centered in each die.
- The 20% critical + 10% redundant case contains 25% logical signals and 30% active physical pads.
- The 25% and 20% + 10% cases use the exact same logical main-block footprint: a centered 20% core plus the same outer 5% main blocks.
- CONTACT_AREA_CONSTRAINT and CRITICAL_DIST_CONSTRAINT are both 0.75.
- W2W process defaults are retained, including 400 um blocks, a 150 mm wafer radius, and num_samples = 10000.
- Redundant main/copy blocks use a fixed minimum center spacing of 800 um, leaving one complete 400 um block between them.
- Every overlay case resets NumPy seed to 20260721, so scenario comparisons use identical samples.
- Package-scale columns compound the W2W average per-die yield over exact chiplet counts.
